text:
Alex M: Heads-up — opening the Gamma merge window for the 0.15 release. Plan: freeze new feature PRs at EOD PST tomorrow; focus on bug fixes/backports. Repos in scope: api, runtime, console, sdk. Can teams call out any blockers or ask for manual merges?

Tara P: Runtime team has one blocking PR: runtime#482 (kv-cache race). CI is running, should be green in ~2h. I can merge and cut a patch.

Mike R: Console has two minor CSS fixes; console#711 is ready. Also question on versioning: do we want to tag v0.15.0-rc1 once api bump is in?

Jenni C: SDK still flaking on integ-tests — sdk#324. Trying to unflake but may miss the cutoff. If so, we should cut without SDK and ship a follow-up patch.

Alex M: OK. If SDK misses cutoff, we'll proceed without it and plan 0.15.1 for the SDK fix. Please add changelog entries under /changelogs/unreleased and ping here when done. Cutoff is 16:00 UTC tomorrow.

Tara P: runtime#482 merged, CI passed. Will tag runtime for canary once the API version bump is merged.

Mike R: I can handle the API bump. This is a backwards-compatible addition — bump minor. I'll open api#900 with the package.json bump and changelog entry.

Jenni C: Still seeing flakes, so I think we'll miss cutoff. Can someone add a short note in the changelog referencing sdk#324 so customers know a patch is coming?

Alex M: Yes — please add: "sdk: awaiting patch for auth header flake — will ship as 0.15.1" under the SDK section.

release-bot: deploy-checker: scheduled canary for tag v0.15.0-rc1 at 2026-03-19T18:00:00Z (auto-run once tag exists).

Mike R: Opened api#900 with the bump and changelog. PTAL @Alex M @Jenni C

Alex M: Reviewing now. Quick ask for console: can you pin runtime minor to 1.8.x in console package.json to avoid accidental breaks for the RC?

Tara P: Runtime team will cut 1.8.2 with the fix. No breaking changes.

Jenni C: Added changelog note: "sdk: fix auth header race — targeting 0.15.1" and linked sdk#324.

Alex M: Great. Final checklist: if you touch API schemas, update /docs/openapi/version.md and add a migration note. Otherwise I'll proceed to cut after merges. Thanks all.

Mike R: No schema changes here. Merging & tagging after CI. @release-bot please proceed when tag pushed :pray:

release-bot: Received tag request for v0.15.0-rc1. Waiting for CI statuses: api (pending), runtime (passing), console (pending).

Alex M: Closing loop — runtime merged 1769877900, api merged 1769878000, console merged 1769878050. Tag pushed. Canary scheduled. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!
